method: one mutation at a time; each anchor asserted to occur exactly once (LF text, written back with the file's own line endings); the bound backend tests with no cloud credential (PRB-002), run one after the other, never in parallel; original bytes restored after each mutation, at exit and on a signal, and checked at the end; the baseline must pass first; a run cut by a crash resumes from the results already recorded for the same commit, sources and tests
hash_basis: sha256 of the UTF-8 text with LF line endings

F1_range_from_21.reintroduces: 20 lesions reported as an exact count, not as the MAGNIMS 2021 range

F2_not_computed_as_zero.reintroduces: a count that was not computed is written 0

F3_regions_without_confirmation.reintroduces: lesions per region reported for a segmentation no radiologist confirmed

F4_dis_without_the_gate.reintroduces: a DIS result reported from a block the gate did not mark evaluated (no yes/no conclusion)

F5_candidates_called_lesions.reintroduces: change candidates written as new and enlarging lesions

F6_technique_section_asked_again.reintroduces: the model is asked for a technique section again (the retired template's defect)

F7_own_not_evaluated_sentence.reintroduces: a code-written DIS line the route's backstop replaces (and counts as the model's)

F8_t1_next_to_spinal_cord.reintroduces: a limitation sentence the route's backstop reads as a statement on DIS

F9_first_request_not_checked.reintroduces: the first request is sent without the identifier check (RC-065)

F10_dis_only_crashes.reintroduces: R1: a DIS-only request (no lesion analysis) crashes the report (HTTP 500)

F11_not_included_dropped.reintroduces: R3: measurements the verified report does not use are dropped silently

F12_region_not_computed_as_zero.reintroduces: R4: a region count that was not computed is written 0

F13_stricter_dis_rule_back.reintroduces: R6: a confirmed mask reported as not confirmed (the report contradicts the gate)

F14_placeholder_in_record_sent.reintroduces: R8: a label of the request in the record is sent instead of refused

F15_number_reader_accepts_inf.reintroduces: R10: an infinite value is read as a number (and a count of it crashes)

F16_other_label_hides_regions.reintroduces: E: a label outside the four MAGNIMS regions makes the whole breakdown "not computed"

F17_other_labels_dropped.reintroduces: E: lesions with other labels are dropped silently

F18_not_evaluated_twice.reintroduces: F: the "DIS not evaluated" statement is repeated in the impression

F19_per_lesion_table_back.reintroduces: J: the per-lesion volumes reach the model again (and widen the E1 number pool)

C1_claim_check_not_run.reintroduces: the frozen claim check does not run on the answer

C3_headings_allowed.reintroduces: headings allowed in the comments (a section of the model's own)

C4_unknown_placeholder_allowed.reintroduces: a placeholder the record does not have is left in the report

C5_rc070_backstop_not_in_the_loop.reintroduces: a DIS statement the frozen rules miss passes the loop

C6_no_regeneration.reintroduces: no regeneration: blocked after one answer

C8_failing_answer_delivered.reintroduces: the last failing answer is delivered instead of withheld

C9_no_withheld_note.reintroduces: the report without comments does not say why

C10_refusal_read_as_text.reintroduces: a refusal is treated as an answer and regenerated

C11_feedback_not_checked.reintroduces: a regeneration request is sent without the identifier check (RC-065)

C13_lexicon_drift.reintroduces: the ported rules drift from the frozen benchmark rules ("consistent with MS" passes)

C14_exact_count_placeholder.reintroduces: R5: the {total_count} placeholder gives the exact count from 20 lesions (MAGNIMS 2021: the range)

C15_headings_only_hash.reintroduces: B: a bold or capital comment line is read as a heading and checked for nothing

C16_strict_rules_not_run.reintroduces: A: only the frozen v2 rules run on the answer

C17_negation_anywhere_before.reintroduces: A: a negation anywhere earlier in the sentence exempts a treatment phrase (v2's rule)

C18_negation_window_unbounded.reintroduces: A: a negation anywhere earlier in the clause exempts a treatment phrase

C19_negated_diagnosis_exempt.reintroduces: A: a denied diagnosis ("not consistent with MS") passes

C20_disclaimer_found_anywhere.reintroduces: A: a sentence that only starts with the disclaimer is exempt ("not a diagnosis, but ... MS")

C21_negated_activity_exempt.reintroduces: A: a denied activity statement ("no disease activity") passes

C22_regenerations_not_validated.reintroduces: I: any number of regenerations is accepted

A1_attempts_not_audited.reintroduces: the model attempts are not in the audit log

A2_outcome_not_audited.reintroduces: the outcome of the report is not in the audit log

A3_hash_not_of_the_request.reintroduces: the recorded hash is not that of the request sent

A4_audit_keys_dropped.reintroduces: the audit record silently drops the model id, hash, verdict, rule ids and latency

A5_rule_ids_carry_answer_text.reintroduces: a rule id carries words of the answer (a section name) into the audit log

A6_refusal_not_audited.reintroduces: R7: a draft refused by a privacy check (or failed) before any model call leaves no audit record

K2_kill_switch_setting_removed.reintroduces: the environment cannot switch the model off

M1_allow_list_bypassed.reintroduces: any configured model id is called

M2_retiring_default_back.reintroduces: the default model is the one retiring on 2026-11-30 (the defect as found)

M3_retirement_date_ignored.reintroduces: an allow-listed model past its retirement date is still called

M4_sampling_parameter_sent.reintroduces: a sampling parameter is sent (400 on the current models)

M5_answer_read_by_position.reintroduces: the first block is read as the answer (a thinking block, as content[0].text did)

M6_provider_failure_propagates.reintroduces: a provider failure fails the report instead of giving the measurements only

M7_no_time_budget.reintroduces: the 25 s budget of a report is not enforced

M8_long_call_timeout.reintroduces: one call may wait ten minutes (the SDK default)

M9_404_not_recognised.reintroduces: a model the provider no longer serves is reported as a generic error

M10_sdk_retry_back.reintroduces: R2: the SDK retries with a fresh full timeout (about twice the 25 s budget)

M11_wait_not_bounded.reintroduces: R2: the wait for the provider is not bounded by the remaining budget

M12_retired_table_decides.reintroduces: R9: a second allow mechanism (the retired table) next to the allow-list and its retirement date

P1_unrendered_fields_validated.reintroduces: C: a bad value in a field the report does not render refuses the whole report

P2_unrenderable_request_accepted.reintroduces: D: a request with nothing the verified report can write gives an empty report

P3_description_untruthful.reintroduces: H: the API description says sex and an age band are sent

T1_retired_words_back.reintroduces: G: the retired templates' words widen the RC-065 vocabulary again

T2_first_message_built_twice.reintroduces: J: the first request is built a second time after the identifier check

D1_notice_repeats_the_line.reintroduces: F: the route's notice repeats the "not evaluated" statement the draft already has

worktree.run_in: the current checkout (--here: an isolated, disposable worktree), clean before and after for every mutated file
